claim: Patchline proves cross-tool proof-carrying verdict exchange by projecting three independent migration-safety analyzer formats, Rails strong_migrations, Django migration checks, and Prisma Migrate diagnostics, into PLCI/1 certificates. The gate renders certificates with real repository file digests, parses them through the certificate checker with verification enabled, reconstructs analyzer-specific preserved projections from the parsed certificate only, and requires byte-stable projection equality. Negative controls mutate a preserved risk score, corrupt a digest, omit a preserved field, and submit an unsupported analyzer schema.
